newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Credito Italiano ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Credito Italiano ratings.

text.p: European rating agency IBCA said on Thursday it affirmed the ratings of Credito Italiano SpA at AA minus long-term, and A1 plus short-term.
IBCA said in a statement that the bank's individual rating of B/C and the legal rating of 2 were also affirmed.
Following the acquisition of Credito Romagnolo in 1995, IBCA said the bank was concentrating on integrating the two groups.
Although group profitability has been affected by higher costs, a diversification of the client base has improved consolidated interest margins, IBCA said.

"Lending concentration has been reduced and asset quality remains relatively healthy," the statement said. "The most important task facing the bank now is the reduction of its overheads and an improvement in profitability."
